{{Combat}} [[Mazthoril]] |minor={{Combat}} [[Winterfall Village]] |affiliation= [[Wintersaber Trainers]], [[Darnassus (faction)|Darnassus]], [[Explorers' League]], [[Alliance]], [[Furbolg|Furbolg tribes]], [[Blue dragonflight]], [[Steamwheedle Cartel]] }} '''Winterspring''' (also known as '''Winterspring Valley''')[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/File:WC3-N04.jpg The Druids Arise image description] is a snowy valley located in [[Northern Kalimdor]], east of [[Felwood]], northeast of [[Hyjal]], and north of [[Azshara]]. It holds the [[goblin]] trading post of [[Everlook]], old [[night elf]] ruins, and the vast cave [[Mazthoril]], the traditional homeland of the [[blue dragonflight]].
